A wiry curio-dealer with vivid damselfly wings in cobalt-blue and silver-streaked black hair, wearing a layered acorn-brown petal-silk coat with brass-seed buttons, unpacks a crate of bottled whispers and crystal snail-shells while shoppers crowd: one in a bluebell gossamer gown with clear dragonfly wings and copper plaits sceptical-eyed, one matronly in a rose leaf-dress with moth-white wings and chestnut curls looking curious, one in a moss-green velvet tunic with lacewing-amber wings and strawberry hair eager-leaned, one sleepy in a mushroom-cream wrap with petal-wings and silver braids clutching an acorn basket, every ear pointed.

A cheerful baker with broad luna-moth wings in pale sage and marigold curls escaping a grass-woven cap, wearing a warm petal-pink apron-dress over a leaf-green undergown, slides a tray of moonflower tarts toward a delighted shopper in a flowing bluebell gossamer dress with dragonfly wings and silver braids, two more fae leaning over the counter — one in a berry-red petal bodice with lacewing-gold wings and black sleek hair, one round-cheeked in an acorn-brown velvet skirt with moth-cream wings and chestnut curls — and one behind in a mushroom-cream wrap with beetle-shell wings, all pointed-eared.

A shrewd spice-seller with lacewing-amber wings and moss-green waves falling to the shoulder, wearing a rich saffron petal-bodice over an ink-dark leaf-skirt, pours violet salt from a twist of bark-paper as four shoppers press the stall: one in a bluebell petal-dress with dragonfly wings and strawberry plaits haggling hard, one matronly in a rose gossamer gown with silver hair and petal-wings, one wiry in an acorn-brown velvet tunic with beetle-shimmer wings and marigold hair, one in a mushroom-cream wrap with moth-dusty wings and black curls looking curious, every ear pointed and lovely.

A potion-seller with great peacock-moth wings and chestnut curls pinned with crystals, wearing a deep plum petal-silk gown belted with woven silver grass, holds a spiral flask of dawn-light toward a round-cheeked shopper in a rose leaf-dress with clear dragonfly wings and marigold plaits, three more pressing close: one willowy in a bluebell gossamer bodice with lacewing-gold wings and silver braids, one in a moss-green velvet tunic with berry-red trim and amber moth wings, one sleepy in a mushroom-cream wrap with beetle-blue wings and black sleek hair, all faces full, ears tipped.

A silver-haired trinket-peddler with translucent petal-wings flushed lavender and chestnut hair in twin plaits, wearing a flowing rose gossamer gown over a moss-velvet petticoat, displays thorn-clasps and pressed-flower brooches while shoppers cluster close: one in a deep bluebell leaf-bodice with dragonfly wings and marigold curls cradling a snail-shell pannier, one wiry in an acorn-brown woven-grass tunic with lacewing-copper wings and strawberry plaits, one matronly in a mushroom-cream dress with wide moth-cream wings and silver braids, one in a berry-red petal skirt with beetle-green wings and black sleek hair, every ear pointed.
